title: Houthis Claim Attack on Aramco Facilities; Saudi Coalition Calls Claim 'Misleading'
detail: Houthi forces claimed responsibility for an attack on Saudi Aramco oil facilities as the Yemen conflict continued to escalate, citing the strikes as retaliation for the Saudi-led coalition's military operations. The Saudi-led coalition dismissed the Houthi claim as 'misleading', characterizing it as propaganda intended to exaggerate the group's capabilities and impact on Saudi infrastructure.

media.caption: Houthis claim attack on Aramco facilities as Yemen conflict escalates

title: Yemen Presidency Announces Military Drive to Retake All Houthi Territory; Houthis Advance on Taiz
detail: Yemen's internationally recognized presidency declared a major military offensive to retake all Houthi-held territory, signaling a significant escalation in the ground war. Simultaneously, Houthi forces were reported advancing on Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, intensifying ground combat on multiple fronts and raising fears of a broader offensive push by both sides.

media.caption: Yemen presidency announces military drive to retake Houthi-held territory as fighting escalates near Taiz
